name: FedAvgRoundStarted
trigger: S1/S4: enter loop and publish ROUND_STARTED; no abort or task-status guard here.

name: FedAvgResetAggregation
trigger: S3/S4: selected cohort fixed by configuration; reset helpers and callback count.

name: WFCommScheduleTask
trigger: S1/S5: broadcast publication; snapshot is not yet made; source model stays separate.

name: WFCommProcessTaskRequest
trigger: S1: admit first retrieval under runner/communicator locks; one active task; supported selected client.

name: WFCommResendTask
trigger: S1/S2: retry after failed outbound delivery, preserving ClientTask ID; no duplicate retraining is assumed.

name: BasePrepareTaskData
trigger: S1: BEFORE_TRAIN_TASK returns normally; no arbitrary shared input mutation.

name: BasePrepareTaskDataFailure
trigger: S4: declared before-send event-handler runtime error marks ERROR; deepcopy is still attempted.

name: WFCommProtectBroadcast
trigger: S1: first retrieval deep-copies task data once; subsequent retrievals reuse the protected version.

name: WFCommProtectBroadcastFailure
trigger: S4: ordinary deepcopy allocation failure; no unprotected send fallback.

name: WFCommCheckCanSend
trigger: S1/S4: selected Task has no after-send callback; final status check precedes task-map publication.

name: WFCommPublishClientTask
trigger: S1: copy per-client headers and publish the envelope; payload still awaits outer filtering/delivery. Release both locks.

name: WFCommTaskTryAgain
trigger: S4: failed preparation returns TRY_AGAIN without registering a new client task.

name: ServerRunnerFilterTask
trigger: S1/S4: no filter or successful configured filter; modeled filters preserve logical model provenance.

name: ServerRunnerFilterFailure
trigger: S4: configured outbound filter raises an ordinary runtime exception; cancellation is a later lock-taking step.

name: WFCommHandleException
trigger: S4: acquire runner wf_lock (not communicator lock); cancel only if client-task mapping still exists; no run abort.

name: ClientReceiveTask
trigger: S1/S2: delivery and decode complete for this envelope; assignment alone promises neither.

name: TaskDeliveryFailure
trigger: S1/S4 payload interface: ordinary envelope delivery failure before execution; no byte/chunk model.

name: ClientProcessTask
trigger: S2/S3: cooperative FULL reply, same task ID/cookie and round; one result per client-task; empty parameters can be deliberately skipped.

name: ClientExecutionError
trigger: S5: ordinary executor exception produces a nonfatal-to-runner EXECUTION_EXCEPTION reply with original identity.

name: ClientCheckTask
trigger: S2: task-check precedes submission; terminal-but-still-mapped tasks return OK; delayed checked sends may arrive after retirement.

name: ClientRetryResult
trigger: S2: retry after ambiguous/lost reply; retain task identity, re-check mapping; the old queued dispatch may still finish.

name: ServerRunnerProcessSubmission
trigger: S2/S4: acquire caller wf_lock and check runner admission once; abort has set runner status=done.

name: WFCommDispatchSubmission
trigger: S2: live terminal/receipt guards and finite-history guard retained; unknown route has no aggregation callback.

name: BaseAcceptTrainResult
trigger: S3/S5: default all-selected dynamic tolerance is zero; non-OK sets panic unless resilient; conversion/consumer exceptions do not use this helper.

name: BaseConvertResult
trigger: S3: successful FLModel conversion; consumer invocation begins only afterward.

name: BaseConvertResultFailure
trigger: S3: declared ordinary conversion allocation/interface failure; no consumer and no tolerance-helper panic.

name: FedAvgAggregateOneResult
trigger: S3: empty params returns False; otherwise enter built-in helper with valid uniform keys and positive symbolic unit weights.

name: WeightedAddParamStats
trigger: S3: helper lock retained throughout add; per-key count precedes lazy materialization.

name: WeightedAddParamValue
trigger: S3: successful materialization and arithmetic apply one key; source values are not mutated; provenance represents total and weight together.

name: WeightedParamFailure
trigger: S3: declared lazy disk I/O or ordinary allocation failure before this key value update; prior key updates and stats survive; callback catch returns rejected.

name: WeightedAddParamHistory
trigger: S3: history appended only after every parameter key; helper lock then releases.

name: FedAvgProcessMetrics
trigger: S3/S5: missing metrics disables round-level metrics; empty metrics skips this contribution; present metric enters helper only while allMetrics is true.

name: FedAvgMetricPreparationFailure
trigger: S3: ordinary metric-filter allocation failure AFTER completed parameter history, before count increment.

name: WeightedAddMetricStats
trigger: S3: one symbolic aggregatable metric key; stats precede arithmetic.

name: WeightedAddMetricValue
trigger: S3: successful metric key arithmetic; history and FedAvg callback count remain separate.

name: WeightedMetricFailure
trigger: S3: ordinary metric arithmetic allocation failure before the metric value update; parameter contribution is not rolled back.

name: WeightedAddMetricHistory
trigger: S3: finish metric helper; count increment occurs in next step.

name: FedAvgIncrementReceived
trigger: S3: callback returns True after count increment; definitive event still not published.

name: BasePublishAcceptance
trigger: S3: current consumer-first accepted decision is retained; reject on conversion/consumer exception or empty skip.

name: BaseClearTrainingResult
trigger: S3/S4: finally clears context/result references; no helper rollback. PC records cleanup, without retaining model data.

name: WFCommStampReceipt
trigger: S2/S3/S4: receipt after the callback, even if mark-only cancellation interleaved; release locks and complete server dispatch.

name: BaseProcessUnknownResult
trigger: S2: unknown train result calls only preliminary acceptance with errors ignored; NO callback, count, history or acceptance event.

name: WFCommDropSubmission
trigger: S2: duplicate/terminal/unknown/closed-workflow dispatch finishes without a contribution; command still returns non-None.

name: ServerCommandDispatchAck
trigger: S2: successful delivery of transport OK acknowledges command dispatch, including semantic drops.

name: ClientLoseDispatchAck
trigger: S2 payload interface: server handled result but client observed timeout/lost reply; no rollback of receipt/acceptance.

name: WFCommCancelTask
trigger: S4: supported direct cancellation is mark-only and takes no communicator/callback lock; admitted work can finish.

name: WFCommReportDeadClient
trigger: S5: first ordinary dead-client report starts grace; dead-client lock excludes monitor observation loop.

name: WFCommClientIsActive
trigger: S5: supported activity/heartbeat clears reported and disconnected state under runner and dead-client locks.

name: ClockAdvance
trigger: S5 environment clock: one 30-second tick, saturating at task lead=30s and report grace=60s. No task timeout. This is a declared time-grid abstraction.

name: WFCommMonitorBegin
trigger: S5: live monitor starts dead-client observation, holding the dead-client lock through this loop.

name: WFCommCheckDeadClient
trigger: S5: process one report; only grace-expired reported clients become disconnected.

name: WFCommDeadCheckDone
trigger: S5: release dead-client lock and begin per-client deployment-policy reads; no snapshot lock is invented.

name: WFCommReadPolicyClient
trigger: S5: policy samples disconnect status per client; recovery may interleave, so deadView is a cached observation.

name: WFCommJobPolicyDecision
trigger: S5: all dead, below min_sites or a required site dead panics and stops this monitor BEFORE check_tasks.

name: WFCommMonitorAcquire
trigger: S4/S5: acquire communicator and task locks; submission callback must have finished before monitor can inspect/remove.

name: WFCommMonitorSelect
trigger: S4/S5: terminal status first, then ALL receipt markers, then dead-client lead time. No timeout=0 branch.

name: WFCommReadTaskDeadClient
trigger: S5: scan outstanding target; encountering any live target ends dead-client scan immediately.

name: WFCommTaskDeadCheckDone
trigger: S5: task CLIENT_DEAD needs nonempty outstanding set observed disconnected; a missing live client keeps standing.

name: WFCommMonitorMarkTerminal
trigger: S4/S5: record manager/dead-check result after observation; mark-only cancellation may interleave with this assignment.

name: WFCommMonitorRemove
trigger: S2/S4: queue length becomes zero and received ClientTasks enter ordered finite history; communicator lock retained until exit cleanup.

name: WFCommMonitorCleanup
trigger: S4: nonblocking FedAvg task has no task_done_cb; delete broadcast copy AFTER removal. Version retained only as a trace/provenance ghost.

name: WFCommMonitorNoTask
trigger: S4/S5: empty standing queue; no callbacks or policy-independent retirement is invented.

name: FedAvgPollStanding
trigger: S4: read queue length without communicator lock; status and abort are NOT checked when the queue is empty.

name: FedAvgPollAbort
trigger: S4/S5: abort polling occurs only after a nonempty queue observation; no global abort guard on all actions.

name: FedAvgGetAggregationStats
trigger: S3: copy actual helper histories and stats into aggregate-result observation before get_result resets helpers.

name: WeightedGetParamResult
trigger: S3: aggregate successful key updates, then reset parameter helper. Normal positive-weight arithmetic preserves symbolic provenance.

name: WeightedGetMetricResult
trigger: S3/S5: allMetrics false suppresses metric output and skips get_result entirely; do not conflate partial helper state with used metrics.

name: FedAvgBuildAggregateResult
trigger: S3: FLModel metadata uses callback received_count independently from helper stats.

name: BaseFedAvgUpdateModel
trigger: S3/S4: FULL result becomes global model; committed observation includes rejected partial updates if implementation retained them. No status/acceptance guard.

name: FedAvgSaveModel
trigger: S3/S4: declared successful persistor/file save observation; no durability claim. No task-status guard.

name: FedAvgAdvanceRound
trigger: S4: ordinary next loop or Finished FedAvg observation; aborted runner is still separately observable through wf.abort.

name: ServerRunnerCloseWorkflow
trigger: S2/S4: after control_flow return, close current_wf under runner lock before communicator finalization.

name: WFCommFinalizeRun
trigger: S2/S4/S5: finalization waits for communicator lock; synchronously drain remaining tasks and clear completed history; no rollback of accepted work.

name: ServerRunnerTaskRequestActive
trigger: S1/S5: request activity clears dead state before the separate get-task lock acquisition; capture only task-relevant polls.

name: ServerRunnerAcquireTaskRequest
trigger: S1/S4: acquire wf_lock before waiting for communicator; monitor may still own communicator.

name: WFCommTaskUnavailable
trigger: S1/S4: stale task-relevant poll finds no eligible task after waiting; unmodeled no-op polling is not silently allowed to change state.

name: ServerRunnerCheckTaskActive
trigger: S2/S5: task-check activity reporting releases wf_lock before the separate mapping lookup.

name: ServerRunnerSubmissionActive
trigger: S2/S5: admitted submission clears disconnect state while retaining caller wf_lock; dead-report checks may run independently before communicator is acquired.

name: WFCommAcquireSubmission
trigger: S2/S3: acquire communicator after caller admission; a newly triggered abort does not retroactively revoke the admitted handler.

name: ServerRunnerDropClosedSubmission
trigger: S2/S4: closed/done runner returns before activity or communicator dispatch; command ACK remains distinct.
